method: Compared selected original local PDF/OCR page text with clause location and historical question/answer inventory; lexical neighbors were manually inspected. This is preliminary content screening, not independent human approval or a visual check of all 18 PDF pages.

rejection_reason.I120-C012: Prior P1-Q008 already asks all three specifications for passenger door safety interlock, including GB 55033-2022. Asking only its start/isolated operation branch is overlapping evidence, not a fresh independent fact.

important_limits: Same article exclusion and lexical nearest-neighbor triage cannot establish semantic independence; review prior broad questions and answers for hidden overlap.
Source excerpts are truncated and may include following clauses; gold evidence quotes must be narrowed to the exact provision before freeze.
Numeric comparison directions, OCR unit fidelity, PDF visual pages and conflicts/supersession remain to be checked case by case.
